paragraphs.text: 1. MAY Surya guard us out of heaven, and Vata from the firmament,
2. Thou Savitar whose flame deserves hundred libations, be thou pleased:
paragraphs.original: जोषा सवितर्यस्य ते हरः शतं सवाँ अर्हति ।
paragraphs.translit: joṣā savitaryasya te haraḥ śataṃ savām̐ arhati |

paragraphs.text: From failing lightning keep us safe.
3. May Savitar the God, and may Parvata also give us sight;
paragraphs.original: चक्षुर्नो देवः सविता चक्षुर्न उत पर्वतः ।
paragraphs.translit: cakṣurno devaḥ savitā cakṣurna uta parvataḥ |

paragraphs.text: May the Creator give us sight.
4. Give sight unto our eye, give thou our bodies sight that they may see:
May we survey, discern this world.
5. Thus, Surya, may we look on thee, on thee most lovely to behold,
paragraphs.original: सुसंदृशं त्वा वयं प्रति पश्येम सूर्य ।
paragraphs.translit: susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayaṃ prati paśyema sūrya |

paragraphs.text: See clearly with the eyes of men.
